blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY — Residents of Puerto Princesa, Palawan were startled by explosions that echoed across the skies on Thursday morning as a Long March-12 rocket launched by China entered its final stage. The explosions startled residents who heard the loud booms and saw a trail of smoke across the sky. The residents heard the sounds at 8:45 a.m., which were sonic booms produced by the rocket as it traveled through the atmosphere.
